queries.sql: SELECT piq.*, tx.tax_percentage, tx.tax_name, productinitial_quantity + IFNULL(ppd.new_purchased,0) AS total_stock FROM product_inital_stock as piq LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id,SUM(quantity) as new_purchased FROM product_purchase_details GROUP BY product_id ) as ppd ON piq.product_id = ppd.product_id LEFT JOIN tax as tx ON piq.tax_id = tx.tax_id
